craft_notes: Sthāyin: putraka-dīkṣā unit 4 — śānta-vidhi of rite-order (owner reviews first-verse of chapter). lines: Samaya-ending rite done on day three,
Then from the mandala's front, Aiśa-corner
beginning, up to āgneya's end, in row-order:
l4.sanskrit_cite: samayyantaṃ vidhiṃ kṛtvā tṛtīye 'hni triśūlābje maṇḍale sāmudāyikaṃ yāgaṃ pūjayet tatra bāhyaparivāraṃ dvāradevatācakraṃ ca bahiḥ pūjayet tato maṇḍalapūrvabhāge aiśakoṇāt ārabhya āgneyāntaṃ paṅktikrameṇa gaṇapatiṃ guruṃ paramaguruṃ parameṣṭhinaṃ pūrvācāryān yoginīcakraṃ vāgīśvarīṃ kṣetrapālaṃ ca pūjayet

reads_against.argmap: What is the third-day mandala-worship order? → The pūjā-krama: three-day samaya-close, then sequential deity-installation from Aiśa to āgneya.
c1_essence: Third-day samaya-close; group-sacrifice in trident-lotus mandala; Aiśa-to-āgneya row of deities installed.
